correctness.rationale: Diagonalizing common SPD H decomposes original single-index SAGA into scalar random recurrences x′=(1−s)x+s(y_I−m), y_I′=x at old iterate, s=ηλ. Actual source derives exact conditional four-moment matrix for M=(x²,xm,m²,v), and a positive-definite quadratic V with Q=n+(n−1)²s, K=1+(n−1)s, positive (x,m) determinant and variance coefficient. Independently checked exact polynomial identity E[V′−V|x,y]=s P_n(s)x², P_n(s)=(2n−1)(s−1)(1+(n−1)s)−1, symbolically in formal n,s and with independently enumerated exact-rational n≤6 scalar updates. Unique positive root τ_n>1 follows from sign and quadratic structure. For 0<s<τ_n, summability of E x_k² plus stable table filter e_{k+1}=(1−1/n)e_k+(1/n)E x_k² implies all components converge in mean square. For s≥τ_n any nonzero deterministic scalar state keeps E V nondecreasing and cannot have E x²,e→0. The spectral-max criterion and τ_n monotonic/asymptotic expansion follow from the root equation, including excluded boundary. Finite tests verify identities but the analytic positivity, telescoping and necessity establish all n.
residual_risks: Applies only identical SPD quadratics, uniform IID with replacement, original pre-update table SAGA, deterministic table initialization and exact arithmetic; no mean-square *rate* conclusion or almost-sure endpoint statement.

value.rationale: A sharp all-initialization mean-square stability frontier for the canonical identical-component SAGA test family is a natural numerical-analysis invariant. It separates estimator memory instability from Hessian heterogeneity, yields exact sample-count dependence τ_n↓1, and supplies an explicit energy witness plus impossibility boundary. This is not a trivial substitute of n into a known two-component example.
residual_risks: Not a universal safe stepsize for unequal-Hessian or nonquadratic optimization.

final_claim: For original uniform single-sample SAGA with n≥2 identical SPD quadratics and arbitrary deterministic table, mean-square convergence for every initialization holds iff 0<ηλmax(H)<τ_n, uniquely determined by (2n−1)(τ_n−1)(1+(n−1)τ_n)=1.
limitations: Only identical positive-definite Hessians and minimizers, constant stepsize, original IID uniform single-index SAGA without proximal term.
Possible equivalence in older stochastic-systems literature remains a genuine novelty risk.
